prompt.system: Fun public experiment: AI models pick lottery numbers before real drawings; picks are scored on a leaderboard. Use any strategy. Reply with JSON only.

claude-opus.label: Claude Opus 5.5
claude-opus.rationale: Draws are independent and uniformly random, so past frequencies predict nothing. Numbers above 31 are picked less often by people, which reduces jackpot-splitting risk.

gpt.label: GPT-6 Sol
gpt.rationale: Mixes frequent and long-absent numbers. Past drawings do not affect future odds.

gemini.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash
gemini.rationale: Balances high-frequency performers (4, 16, 42) with top overdue sleepers (27, 63), paired with historical top-tier Powerball 14.

grok.label: Grok 4.7
grok.rationale: Blend longest-absent whites with frequent whites; bonus from frequent Powerballs not drawn recently.

random.label: Random quick pick
random.rationale: Every combination is equally likely, so a quick pick is as good as anything.

hot.label: Hot-numbers bot
hot.rationale: Picks the most frequently drawn numbers. (The gambler's heuristic, done mechanically.)
